I'll review the PR from `PR.diff` and the related source in this workspace, focusing on the categories you listed.I'll inspect the changed delivery, grant, and review-count paths in the source next.## Fail-open error paths

**Major — `.claude/plugins/ccv3-mods/hooks/pr-loop/index.ts:211-213`**  
`liveAlert` returns the original alert when the re-probe fails (`result.kind !== 'ok'`), so a transient `gh`/status failure still toasts and can `prompt.submit` a LIMITED/PROOF/STALLED/REVIEWED line. That can tell the model to act on a PR that was already merged or fixed (SP6 encodes this as intended; it is still fail-open).

## Missed events

**Major — `.claude/plugins/ccv3-mods/hooks/pr-loop/index.ts:219-225`**  
`submitLine` writes the `sent` ledger (`markSent` / `saveDoc`) *before* `$.prompt.submit`. If submit throws or is dropped, that `alertKey` is treated as delivered forever (until `SENT_MAX` eviction), so the model never gets the line.

**Minor — `.claude/plugins/ccv3-mods/hooks/pr-loop/index.ts:122-125` with `model.ts:260-261`**  
`saveDoc` deletes the whole watch doc when `prs.length === 0`, which also drops `sent`. Re-watching the same PR/head/reason after the last watch entry clears can re-fire a model line the ledger had already recorded.

## External-data trust

**Major — `scripts/github/review-status.mjs:864-866`**  
`coderabbitFinishedOf` treats any CodeRabbit review with a non-empty body as finished and does not call `codeRabbitNotice`. Elsewhere notices are explicitly “never a review” (e.g. `codeRabbitOutsideFindings` at 833, `codeRabbitHeadReview` at 340). A rate-limit/skip/fail notice with a body inflates `coderabbitReviews`, and under limit `roundsOf` uses `Math.min(total, finished)`, so the SP8 “request is not a round” fix can still count a notice as a finished round.

**Minor — `scripts/github/review-status.mjs:865-866`**  
Distinct count is `new Set(bot.map(r => r.commit_id)).size` with no check that `commit_id` is a 40-char sha. Missing/null `commit_id` values collapse to one bucket, so finished-review counts from GitHub can be wrong.

## Partial writes

**Major — `.claude/plugins/ccv3-mods/hooks/pr-checkpoint/index.tsx:531-535`**  
`grantCommand` writes `checkpoint:grant:<pr>` first, then clears a covered `declined`. If the second `store.set` fails (or a watcher tick runs in between), grant and decline both exist. `budgetSentence` / `checkpointAllowsPost` still prefer any `cp.declined` over grant (`model.ts:404-405`, `422-426`), so model lines keep saying “Dave declined… Do not request a review” after a successful grant.

**Minor — `.claude/plugins/ccv3-mods/hooks/pr-checkpoint/index.tsx:531-545`**  
Grant, decline clear, ask-queue clear, and `tellModel` are separate steps with no rollback. A failure after grant + `tellModel` can leave the pane ask queued so a later No writes `declined` and overrides the grant in report lines (the comment at 537-538 calls this out; the code only mitigates when the queue filter/save succeeds).

## Input validation

**Minor — `.claude/plugins/ccv3-mods/hooks/pr-checkpoint/model.ts:87-96` and `index.tsx:531`**  
`parseGrantArgs` only requires `pr >= 1` and `round >= 1` (no upper bound, no live head/budget check). `/pathway grant <pr> 999` stores a grant that satisfies `granted >= round` for every future round ask (`askFor` at `model.ts:591`) and suppresses further budget prompts.

**Minor — `.claude/plugins/ccv3-mods/hooks/pr-checkpoint/index.tsx:531`**  
Grant `head` is always `stored.head` (pathway apply head), while pane Yes uses `ask.head` (status head at ask time). `grantRound` ignores `head`, so this is mostly inconsistent metadata today, but it diverges from the pane path and from the README’s “on the record head” story whenever the PR has moved on.
